criterion: PASS iff: exact counterexample has both errors <1e-8 and amp ratio >=1e3; noisy fixed-rank 5%-error window has amp ratio >=2; and at least two RBRP families have amp ratio >=2 at the same rank within a 10%-error window.
interpretation: PASS supports only the Stage-1 claim that approximation error does not by itself control interpolation amplification, including for unmodified RBRP outputs. It does not prove a theorem about all matrices, nor that the proposed Stage-2 refinement will help.
